name: Crusader
source:
One of Magician Genovieve's Peacemakers, belonging to the powerful but often mentally unstable Crusader class. Adopted by the Peacemakers without knowing his actual name, they simply referred to him as Crusader until he decided on a name for himself, which he never did.

He's a Moon Rabbit, a rare organic-mechanical species with indefinite lifespans. As a child, he was caged and forced to fight others, including his own brother who died protecting him. These experiences left the sensitive boy speech-impaired, and as an adult he's unable to convey his feelings with words well.

However, as a Moon Rabbit, he can easily sense the emotions of people around him, and reacts kindly to those having a difficult time. Although he may look scary and stoic, he's actually very shy and simply doesn't know how to express himself and the warmth in his heart.

[From [url=https://toyhou.se/12614116.crusader]official bio[/url]]
